## 11. Closing state (2026-09-07 evening)

Plan review round 5 for helpless-carnelian-megaraptor (config shim removal) PASSED and is certified (verified_at_sha 665d1d04, signed 1788839432; two deferred advisories, P6 wording and a G1G2 note, both far below their block lines). All four land-first stories are now certified: bossy-poetic-polliwog (library annotations), skaldic-paradoxal-huemul (seam-guard deletion), gunshy-symmetric-barnacle (reconciler package move; reads stale-code because CHANGELOG moved beneath it, accepted at claim), helpless-carnelian-megaraptor (config shim removal). The shim story took five rounds; every block was a real grounding defect and each is summarized in a comment on the story.

The remaining 45 stories still need their own plan reviews before claim; bug amoeboid-amateur-guillemot (1768) must land before any mechanism-deleting story; the reconciler move needs the operator's force-submit when the complexity lock is its only red CI item. This log (entries 1 to 11) is the durable record of the session; nothing decision-bearing remains only in scratch.
